Antisemitism: In 2019, Rosen co-founded the Senate Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism with Sen. James Lankford (R-OK). In 2024, she introduced the Countering Antisemitism Act to establish an interagency task force to counter antisemitism. She noted "skyrocketing antisemitism in the United States and the world" after the Oct. 7 Hamas-led attacks on Israel.
